notes: IEEE Std 802.3-2005 does NOT specify on-chip calibration loops. The MAC + RS + MII subset is purely digital and is verified by directed and randomized testbench stimulus. The PHY-side analog (line drivers, hybrids, ADC, DAC, equaliser, clock recovery) requires per-PMD compliance lab tests (oscilloscope eye-diagram + return-loss + NEXT + jitter / wander measurement) per the relevant clause's PMD specification. Vendor PHYs implement closed-loop adaptive equalization + impedance trim + amplitude trim as implementation-defined features outside the protocol scope.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MII / GMII output drive (Voh / Vol)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify Clause 22.4.3.1 DC characteristics — Voh ≥ 2.40 V at Ioh = -4 mA; Vol ≤ 0.40 V at Iol = 4 mA.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MII / GMII input thresholds (Vih / Vil)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify Clause 22.4.4.1 — Vih(min) = 2.00 V; Vil(max) = 0.80 V; receiver behaviour undefined in the switching region.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: TX_CLK / RX_CLK frequency + tolerance
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure 25 MHz ±100 ppm at 100 Mb/s, 2.5 MHz at 10 Mb/s, 125 MHz GTX_CLK at 1 Gb/s; verify duty cycle in 35-65 %.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MII setup / hold timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify TXD / TX_EN / TX_ER setup ≥ 10 ns and hold ≥ 0 ns relative to TX_CLK; clock-to-output ≤ 25 ns on RX side.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MDC / MDIO timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify MDC period ≥ 400 ns, high + low ≥ 160 ns; MDIO setup + hold relative to MDC rising edge.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PHY MDI signaling eye + amplitude
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Per-PMD class eye-diagram + return-loss + far-end NEXT compliance: 10BASE-T (Clause 14), 100BASE-TX (Clause 25), 1000BASE-T (Clause 40 + Annex 40C).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: AutoNeg FLP pulse spacing + burst timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Pulse spacing 62.5 ± 7 µs; burst interval 8-24 ms; verify on twisted pair with a digital oscilloscope before line-coded data signaling begins.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Frame-level FCS check
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject known test vector (e.g. ASCII '123456789' → CRC-32 0xCBF43926; or a captured Ethernet frame against external utility) and compare RTL CRC engine output.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Inter-Frame Gap measurement
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: On the wire (or on the MII), measure the time between TX_EN ↓ of one frame and TX_EN ↑ of the next; must be ≥ 96 BT for the configured speed.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Protocol analyzer (Wireshark / Keysight)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Capture and decode Ethernet frames + VLAN tags + PAUSE frames + AutoNeg pages on the MDI; cross-check against the RTL transmit / receive output.
